summary: Targeted re-test of iteration_1 fixes (frontend only, public preview URL). VERIFIED FIXED: (1) Dashboard /app at 390px -> scrollWidth-innerWidth = 0, 'Начать' buttons (x=218,w=114) and 'Весь план' link fully inside viewport; (2) AI Tutor /app/tutor at 390px -> overflow = 0 before and after an AI answer; chat-input (right=288), chat-send-btn (right=361) and chat-messages (right=373) all inside 390px; quick-action chips scroll inside their own overflow-x-auto track without widening the page; (3) diagnostic-only stats: seeded brand-new account (register->onboarding->10-question diagnostic->finish, no practice) and logged in via UI — Dashboard stat cards show 'Заданий решено 10', 'Средний результат 30%', 'Общий прогресс 30%'; Statistics page renders 4 stat cards, subject bar chart (1 bar) and 5 weak topics with real values. Sanity: login OK, dashboard loads, AI tutor returned a real Claude answer (277 chars, Russian, personalized to weak topic — not a fallback), Statistics bar tooltip is localized ('Математика / Уровень : 30%', no 'mastery').

issues: Task titles truncate to 'Математи...' and the difficulty badge ('Лёгкий') is clipped at the edge of the shrink-0 'Начать' button; consider stacking title/meta above the button on <sm or shortening the button to an icon
Empty-state text says 'Пройди диагностику и создай план, чтобы получить задания' even though the diagnostic is already completed — copy should be 'Создай план...' when has_diagnostics=true
With a single day of data the card shows only the hint text and no point/line; acceptable but a single-point dot would look less empty

Optional copy fix: dashboard empty-state should not ask to pass the diagnostic when it is already completed

critical_code_review_comments: routes_diagnostic.finish_diagnostic now inserts question_attempts with source='diagnostic' — verified working, but it has no idempotency guard: calling /finish twice would duplicate the 10 attempts and inflate tasks_completed. Recommend a guard on diag['status'] == 'completed' (or upsert by (user_id, question_id, source))
Local import 'from auth_utils import new_id as _nid' inside finish_diagnostic should move to module-level imports
